summary: Merge PLATE PR gate workflows into a single pr-gates job to cut billed Actions minutes while preserving gate logic and failure messages.
migration_impact: Branch protection must require pr-gates instead of legacy per-gate job contexts; run gh plate health to detect stale names.
migration_guidance: Import plate-pr-gates.yml and delete pr-title-check, pr-issue-link-check, pr-documentation-check, feedback-resolution-check, and audit workflows.
Update required checks to labels, test, and pr-gates (see docs/migration/actions-cost-rollout.md).
Remove deprecated contexts: check-pr-title, check-issue-links, feature-change-files, feedback-resolution, audit, validate-release-pr.
agent_notes: validate-release-pr moved from ci.yml into pr-gates; heavy-release in ci.yml depends on test only. Builder: scripts/build_plate_pr_gates_workflow.py regenerates YAML from step anchors.
